PlacementNoticeKind.description: What a notice of a pool says about a node.

oneOf.description: The node was not heard from for the silence time: it gets no new places. Sent once per silence.
A silent node offered again and is live.

Alert.description:
Sends the alert target a notice about `node`, in a turn of its own so that a failing target fails only this
alert; nothing without a target. Sent by the pool to itself.
Alert.title: Alert

Alerts.description: Sets where the pool's notices go, replacing the target before.

messageType.description:
The message type of the notices, whose payload is a [`PlacementNotice`]; not empty, at most 200 characters,
without NUL.

Alerts.title: Alerts

Check.description:
The silence timer: sent by the pool to itself, and counted only when it is the armed one (`armedId`). Marks each
live node not heard from for the silence time as silent, queues an `Alert` for each, and arms the next check at
the earliest end of a live node's silence. Run early (made due by an operator) it arms itself again at `armed`;
any other `Check` the pool sent itself changes nothing, and one from another sender is refused for good.
Check.title: Check

Offer.description:
A node offers its places: replaces the node's entry with this instance, these labels (sorted, each once) and
places, heard at the store time of this turn, and live. A silent node that offers is told `back` to the alert
target. A node new to a pool that knows `maxNodes` nodes is refused for good. Send one at an interval shorter
than the silence time.

instance.description: An id the member draws at each process start, which tells two processes offering under one node id apart.

labels.description: What the node offers, such as its processor kind: at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

node.description: The node id the member's node pins its actors under.

places.description: How many places the node offers, 0 through 1,000; 0 keeps the node known but full.

Offer.title: Offer

Rearm.description:
Cancels the armed check and arms a new one at its unchanged time, at once when that has passed: the recovery of a
check that was purged, cancelled or failed for good. Nothing when no node is live.
Rearm.title: Rearm

PlacementAlerts.description: Where the notices of a pool go.

messageType.description: The message type of the notices; not empty, at most 200 characters, without NUL.

PlacementNode.description: What a pool knows of a node: its last offer and whether it is heard from.

heardAt.description: The store time of the turn of its last offer.

instance.description: The instance id of its last offer; 1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL.

labels.description: The labels of its last offer, sorted, each once; at most 32, each 1 through 100 characters without NUL.

places.description: The places of its last offer, 0 through 1,000.

PlacementNodeStatus.description: Whether a node of a pool is heard from.

oneOf.description: Heard from within the silence time.
Not heard from for the silence time: it gets no new places until it offers again.

state.description:
The state of a [`Placement`] pool: its silence time and node limit, fixed at its create, where its notices go, the
nodes it knows by node id, and the time and id of its armed check. Build it with `PlacementState::new`; a decoded state is
checked the same way.

On the wire: `{"silence":"PT1M","maxNodes":1000,"alerts":null,"nodes":{},"armed":null,"armedId":null}`; `alerts`,
`nodes`, `armed` and `armedId` may be left out of a create.

alerts.description: Where its notices go; absent or null: no notices.

armed.description: The time of the armed `Check`: present exactly while a node is live.

armedId.description: The id of the armed `Check`: present exactly with `armed`.

maxNodes.description: The most nodes the pool knows; 1 through 1000.

nodes.description:
The nodes it knows, by node id (1 through 200 characters, not blank, without NUL), at most `maxNodes`; absent:
none.

silence.description: How long a node may go without an offer before it is silent, as an ISO-8601 duration; 1 second through 1 day.

state.title: PlacementState
